Step 10:  When the concentration of acetate ions (CH3COO-) is equal to the concentration of nitric acid (HNO3), the buffering capacity of the solution is fully utilized, and the pH begins to change significantly.
Step 11:  Since the concentration of acetic acid is 2.00 moles, and the concentration of calcium acetate is 1.00 mole, the concentration of acetate ions (CH3COO-) is also 1.00 mole.
